notes.title: News about the Full Release Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Since the early access release on Steam, we have been receiving a lot of questions about when it will leave early access and if it will have Steam achievements and such.

We want to confirm that the full release will include achievements!

Not only that, the latest date that you can expect a full release will be April 15th, but it can be sooner than that! ːsteamthumbsupː

Thanks for the support on TGO <3
